actual_viewing.artifact_role: authorized readability derivative, not a new original or a repainted candidate

concrete_observations: Primary buttons are inverse, secondary buttons are white outlined, and the add action is dashed. The annotation explicitly calls for whole-control inverse press feedback.
The dock is pinned to the bottom, with a thick top marker on the current item and gray idle entries. Segmented choices use an inverse selection; text tabs use strong selected text and an underline.
The three filter states are distinct: a neutral outlined chip, an inverse checked included chip, and a dashed/struck excluded chip. Switch on/off examples remain separate.
Chapter row examples keep number, title, dotted leader, date/progress and status aligned. The cover's count badge is placed beside the book name, not painted over the cover title.
The source title opens a source list grouped into built-in and extension sections. Add-source and source-list entries are placed at the bottom of that list.
The toast is white with a black border/text, does not dim or obstruct the background, disappears after two seconds, and refreshes only its own rectangle according to the annotation.

The folio sits directly above the dock without an extra separator. The first page hides Previous and the last page hides Next while preserving the edge allocation. Tapping the center count opens all page numbers upward; horizontal swipes on the list also turn pages.
crop_viewing_records.scope_and_override_exclusions: The reader top/bottom toolbar example applies to open controls only. It does not authorize persistent closed-reader UI; the user's artwork-only override remains binding.

concrete_observations: The scrolling-list card explains that frame-by-frame partial refresh causes ghosting and requires paginated lists with a bottom pager; horizontal swipe can perform the same page transition.
The animation/transition card names fades, slides and spinners as causing repeated display refresh. It specifies direct state changes and textual progress information.

concrete_observations: The shadows/masks/gray-background card says gray surfaces dither into visible grain and masks add full-screen refresh on popup open/close. It uses black outlines and whitespace for depth, reserving gray for state highlighting.
